content: OpenSheetMusicDisplay (OSMD) v2.1.2 renders MusicXML/MXL via VexFlow, exposes GraphicalNote.setColor() for notehead/stem/beam coloring without full re-render, getSVGGElement()/getNoteheadSVGs() for direct SVG access, and Cursor.Iterator with CurrentVoiceEntries for note-by-note traversal with timestamps.
